canonical_title: US DOJ investigates Nvidia-Groq licensing deal
treatment: Repeat only for DOJ findings, charges, settlement, fines, structural remedies, or new transaction details.
known_facts: The New York Times reported that the U.S. DOJ is investigating whether Nvidia structured its $17 billion Groq licensing deal to avoid antitrust scrutiny.
The DOJ reportedly sent Nvidia a formal demand for information.
Reuters reported the investigation but said DOJ and Groq had not commented.
reinclude_only_if: DOJ formally confirms findings or enforcement.
Nvidia or Groq discloses material new transaction or regulatory details.
notes: Underlying investigation details are attributed by Reuters to New York Times sources.
